entries.title: Floating Dye Droplets in a Clear Cube
entries.description: A transparent cubic tank filled with clear fluid where colorful spherical droplets of dye fall, collide, stretch, and dissolve into swirling color clouds, leaving faint trails and gradually mixing into new hues.
entries.seed: Floating Dye Droplets in a Clear Cube: A transparent cubic tank filled with clear fluid where colorful spherical droplets of dye fall, collide, stretch, and dissolve into swirling color clouds, leaving faint trails and gradually mixing into new hues.

entries.title: Orbiting Color Planets That Blend on Impact
entries.description: Dozens of small colored spheres orbit a central light source and occasionally collide, merging into a single sphere whose color is the average of the originals, with labels showing RGB values and fading collision shockwaves.

entries.title: Rotating Paint Palette Disc
entries.description: A flat circular palette divided into colored wedge sectors that slowly spins while small white droplets drop onto it, roll across the surface, and absorb blended colors based on where they travel, leaving streaky trails behind.

entries.title: 3D Colorful Smoke Plumes Mixing in Air
entries.description: Multiple vents on the floor emit semi-transparent particle plumes of red, green, and blue smoke that rise, overlap, and gently swirl under a ceiling fan, with the overlapping regions gradually changing color according to additive mixing.

entries.title: Pouring Colored Liquids into a Tilting Glass
entries.description: Several slender tubes pour different translucent colored liquids into a large glass that slowly tilts back and forth, causing layered bands to flow, fold, and mix into gradients while a side panel shows a live color histogram bar.

entries.title: Colliding Color-Filled Marbles
entries.description: A set of transparent glass marbles, each with a colored core, roll down ramps and collide on a flat table; when two marbles stick together their cores visually blend into a new color and a label hovers showing the resulting mix.

entries.title: 3D Light Beams Intersecting in a Misty Room
entries.description: Narrow red, green, and blue light beams shine from different corners into a slightly foggy room, intersecting in midair to form brighter mixed-color regions, while a movable sensor sphere floats around sampling and displaying the local color.

entries.title: Microscopic Pigment Particles in a Droplet
entries.description: A large transparent sphere represents a water droplet containing many tiny colored particles that diffuse, clump, and detach under gentle random motion, gradually turning the droplet into a uniform mixed color with adjustable temperature (diffusion speed).

entries.title: Color-Mixing Conveyor of Paint Blobs
entries.description: Colored paint blobs drop onto a slowly moving conveyor belt, collide, spread, and merge into streaks; overhead paddles occasionally press and fold the blobs, causing more intense mixing patterns and leaving a drying, semi-glossy surface behind.

entries.title: Color-Changing Fireflies Swapping Glow

entries.title: Additive vs. Subtractive Color Walls
entries.description: Two vertical panels face each other: one made of overlapping translucent RGB sheets lit from behind, the other painted with CMY pigments lit from the front; sliders move sheets and paint layers so overlapping regions change color while labels explain “additive” vs “subtractive” mixing.

entries.title: Molecular-Level Color Diffusion in a Cube

entries.description: A 3D network of nodes connected by glowing tubes passes colored pulses along its links; when pulses meet at a node they merge, and the node’s color becomes the weighted blend of incoming pulses, with brightness showing signal strength.

entries.title: Colored Magnetic Fluids in a Stirred Sphere
entries.description: A transparent spherical container holds several blobs of differently colored ferrofluid that respond to moving magnetic spheres outside; as the magnets orbit and rotate, the colored blobs stretch into spikes, merge, and detach, gradually mixing colors in dynamic shapes.

entries.description: A central fountain shoots upward streams of differently colored particles that arc and fall into a shallow basin; sliders change each jet’s color and height, and as the streams intersect midair they visually mix, with the basin’s water gradually shifting to the combined color.

entries.description: A semi-transparent 3D cube composed of smaller colored sub-cubes can rotate its layers; when two faces of different colors are pressed together, boundary sub-cubes gradually blend into intermediate shades, showing how repeated “scrambling” leads to overall color averaging.
